```artifact
Feature: Speciality and Doctor Management
  Background:
    As an administrator of the VCMSP03 system,
    I want to ensure proper management of Specialities and Doctors,
    so that all operations are error-free and informative.

  Scenario: Display error when Speciality does not exist with Speciality Id
    Given there is no Speciality with the given Speciality Id
    When the system tries to retrieve the Speciality details
    Then an error message "Speciality does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor with generated Id, Name, Age, Sex, Qualification & Experience
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is accessible
    When I select to Add a new Doctor
    And I provide a valid Doctor Id, Name, Age, Sex, Qualification, and Experience
    Then the new Doctor record should be created and displayed

  Scenario: Edit/Update a Doctor with a given Doctor Id
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is accessible
    When I select to Edit/Update a Doctor with a valid Doctor Id
    And I provide the updated details
    Then the Doctor record should be updated

  Scenario: Display Doctor details for Edit/Update with valid Doctor Id
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is accessible
    When I select to Edit/Update a Doctor with a valid Doctor Id
    And I provide the updated details
    Then the Doctor record should be updated

  Scenario: Display error when Doctor does not exist with given Doctor Id
    Given there is no Doctor with the given Doctor Id
    When the system tries to retrieve the Doctor details
    Then an error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Check for open Consultation Requests before Deleting Doctor Details
    Given there is a Doctor with a valid Doctor Id
    And there are open Consultation Requests for this Doctor
    When I attempt to delete the Doctor details
    Then an exception error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" should be displayed

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist/Lab with generated Id, Flag, Name, Address, and Contact Details
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is accessible
    When I select to Add a new Chemist/Lab
    And I provide a valid Chemist/Lab Id, Flag, Name, Address, and Contact Details
    Then the new Chemist/Lab record should be created and displayed

  Scenario: Edit/Update a Chemist/Lab with a given Chemist/Lab Id
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is accessible
    When I select to Edit/Update a Chemist/Lab with a valid Chemist/Lab Id
    And I provide the updated details
    Then the Chemist/Lab record should be updated

  Scenario: Display Chemist/Lab details for Edit/Update with valid Chemist/Lab Id
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is accessible
    When I select to Edit/Update a Chemist/Lab with a valid Chemist/Lab Id
    And I provide the updated details
    Then the Chemist/Lab record should be updated

  Scenario: Display error when Chemist/Lab does not exist with given Chemist/Lab Id
    Given there is no Chemist/Lab with the given Chemist/Lab Id
    When the system tries to retrieve the Chemist/Lab details
    Then an error message "Chemist/Lab does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Check for open Consultation Requests before Deleting Chemist/Lab Details
    Given there is a Chemist/Lab with a valid Chemist/Lab Id
    And there are open Consultation Requests for this Chemist/Lab
    When I attempt to delete the Chemist/Lab details
    Then an exception error message "Chemist/Lab has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" should be displayed
```
